infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Personal Driver Marketplace requires your location to find nearby verified drivers for your vehicle.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Personal Driver Marketplace needs background location during active trips to track driver arrival and route.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Personal Driver Marketplace needs continuous location during an active trip to provide live navigation and passenger safety.
